story.title: The Long Night at Sea
story.story: Columbus stood on the deck of a small wooden ship. The crew had not seen land for many days. They were tired, hungry, and very afraid. Some sailors wanted to turn the ship around and go home. Columbus asked them to wait one more night. That night a sailor saw a small light far away. In the morning they found a green island with tall trees. The long journey across the wide sea was finally over.
